notes.title: Warped Continuum Events Update!
notes.notes:
Warped Continuum Events
The Warped Continuum Event is a new kind of end-game procedural challenge that gets more difficult the further you progress. They are all large enough to accomodate the biggest ships (although some ships modded with the "Big" mod still will require some maneuverability skills :)).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/264d6c49e30e274ee5ae673b1660ddc64afb8990.gif

As the difficulty of these events for the most part is linearly increased based on how far you progress, there should not be any huge difficulty spikes (such as the difficulty gaps between the Minor, Grand, and Uber Continuum Events). 

The Warped Continuum Event loot table differs from regular Continuum Events. In particular, they have a higher likelihood of dropping items that add bonus skill points. They are also the only way to gain In-S Fragments, which add bonus skill points to items (you previously had to find an item with bonus skill points and extract the skills through an Ext-S Fragment). The quality of these items depend on the difficulty of the Warped Continuum Event. The more difficult events have a chance to drop Uber-tier items. 

They start to drop in the Continuum difficulty. You can also craft them using the Random Warped Contained Continuum Event recipe. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e94c870bacb606e23b53006d13b96cf705856b75.png

There is a high-score system in place for these Warped Continuum Events. The difficulty of dropped Warped Continuum Events depend on this high-score. There is also a Continuum Transmuter recipe to reduce the difficulty of a Warped Continuum Event (see Downgrade Warped Continuum Event).

Infinite Warped Continuum Events
I wont say much about these events, apart from that they only drop in Warped Continuum Events...

Major overhaul to the English localization
The English localization has received a complete overhaul, with more than 3000 words having been revised and many entries added! This was done single handedly by Morgan Walter (@syovere on Discord). Many thanks for your hard work!

Customize your Uber rewards
You can now set an item that is desired as reward for completing a given Uber Continuum Event. See the recipe "Set Uber Continuum Event Reward". The idea is to make it easier to farm specific items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/dcd6debaad549a6f3f3726f83da2f34a56131e65.gif

Imperius enemies
You can now encounter Imperius enemies! A total of 16 new Imperius enemies have been added. You can presently encounter these in the Warped Continuum Events.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/56d8598031e41c4bf673ff63bc77ef7355890fa3.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3a93cb5209b825fae04db936425c9412b18eb5ac.gif

New items!
🎯 Two new hangars that summon Imperius fighters have been added to the loot table.
🎯 A new hangar that summon Imperius cruisers has been added to the loot table.
🎯 A new Imperius fighter-class ship has been added to the loot table.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/072aee6784c13c44952c3826f942ea67890e8791.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/d93c06e556caa95bebb283bbe347ed9324edbc22.png

Performance in caves
I have read your feedback on the performance issues in caves (especially in Act 2). 

This patch provides overall performance improvements to caves. Additionally, you can now also opt to render cave walls at a lower resolution (see the image below). This provides greatly increased performance at the cost of a minor (often negligible) reduction in the image quality of cave walls.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/fd5e0392ee1e3e4266dec8518095f7f5957cc1ed.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e39c0b252e73f7b439a9064e300f75bcf5ce2ed2.png

Misc changes
🎯 Many enemy death animations have been polished.
🎯 The Continuum Transmuter UI has received a minor update.
🎯 The names of some world events have been changed.
🎯 A menu battle scene featuring Imperius vs Axiom has been added.

🎯 The "Recommended level" for Continuum Events has been revised.
🎯 Better profiling of hardware info (GPU and available RAM) to reduce the effort required to debug related errors. 
🎯 The warp gate button has been moved (see below image).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/52ac111f9beca6d602a905017feb8b93888c79aa.png

Bug fixes
🎯 Fixed an issue that could cause an infinite loading screen when disconnecting from a PvP or fleet commander game while a map switch was being made.
🎯 Fixed multiple localization issues.

Thanks for your support - I hope you enjoy the new content!

/Hannes

notes.title: Fleet Commander Update!
notes.notes:
It's now been half a year since Nienix reached 1.0!

To celebrate, today's patch (1.050) includes a completely new game mode called Fleet Commander. Apart from this game mode, a whole bunch of other content has been added during the past three months (the time since the last major news update). This post highlights significant changes. As always, follow the patch notes for the complete list.

Fleet Commander
This game mode was inspired by Gratuitous Space Battles and allows you to orchestrate large-scale fleet battles. Play against an AI in the offline mode or a friend through the online modes.

You can only summon foes that you have defeated during the campaign. I hope this feature makes exploring random events more rewarding, as these include enemies that you would not face by solely following the main quest line.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/a29f0a0a08303a558b7ad185429b4667bd00b6f4.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/a9f5ded432c62c7faacf808da9e333dee8709786.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c1ebf60ce3f89a0fc34726114ea386ea4a598ee7.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/a474d312f44ba978e9836f6300cfa4e3e3ce8a6d.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/9404349629716597c15d4e5f644c12b514386b15.gif

Updates to the Continuum Transmuter
I know that many of you have a love/hate relationship with the Continuum Transmuter. It is useful to roll and alter gear, but the process takes a long time - especially during the end-game. Thats why the Continuum Transmuter has been revised. In particular, it now includes the storage. The auto-match-recipes takes the items in the storage into consideration.

Recipe auto-matching also better considers item grades when evaluating what to upgrade. Mythic- and Uber-grade items are no longer automatically selected. The latter was done to ensure that no important end-game items could be transmuted through the auto-matching feature by mistake.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/f2645bfd0ad9e88bb6e341873bddd4b27e7e7177.png

Items can now unlock different skills
Legendary+ tier engines and ships can now roll with unlockable skills (up to tier 5)! Some skills only roll for certain kinds of ships/engines. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/084965112c31b03462ef96cad7b58fa8b43eb9f9.png

The core game engine has been updated
The core game code has been updated to .NET 6.0. This brings many improvements. In particular, newer Linux platforms such as Ubuntu 22 are now supported "out of the box" (there is no longer a need to add older libraries required by the previous game version on such platforms).

Updates for controller players
A new (gamepad-only) radial menu has been added that enables more easily enabling/disabling game screens that previously required two hotkeys pressed in combination (e.g., the inventory or map). The previous keybindings remain as-was; the radial menu is only enabled if the start-button is clicked (rather than pressed). Radial menus now also behave more closely to the variant used in Diablo 3.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c38e64e2b2637ec23042851b58b5ce114db1cc48.png

New items
🎯 [New ship] A new Dreadnought-class ship has been added to the loot table. The default variant of this ship is narrow and 1100m long.
🎯 [Continuum Entity] Ext-S Fragment: Extracts all skill bonuses from an item and stores them in a Continuum Entity. The item is destroyed in the process.
🎯 [Continuum Entity] In-S Fragment: Inserts the skill bonuses in the In-S Fragment to a desired ship or engine. Any existing skill bonuses in that item are replaced.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e3e90d788af564e162a1452d2f6b368e536f97ac.gif

Catalan
The entire game now officially supports Catalan (albeit some polish still remain - the final version is expected to be completed within a few weeks)! This work was made by the Ce Trencada Project, that translates video games into Catalan completely free of charge, altruistically, and with a purely cultural purpose, with the sole objective of promoting the culture of video games in Catalan. 

I deeply appreciate your contribution!

Japanese, German, Portugese, French, Spanish and Swedish
Based on player requests, I've decided to include the machine-made translations for Japanese, German, Portugese, Spanish, French and Swedish in the main branch. These localizations are bound to contain many errors. Please report incorrect texts on Steam or Discord! Or download the localization spreadsheet and correct it yourself. Translation instructions can be found here.

I've decided not to tag the Steam store page with these machine-made translations - only localizations made manually (or at least thoroughly proof-read) are visible on Steam. Additionally, the machine-made translations are highlighted with a red color in the language selection drop-down menu and have a warning text popup.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/e139304eb4c4f81adbfd87c3f0f46312dc5f8495.png

Quality of life
🎯 [Misc] Engine auto-boost and active auxiliary auto-use are now coupled to the two ship hull configs.
🎯 [Misc] Fixed-point weapon auto-fire is now coupled to the two weapon configs.
🎯 [Keybindings] You can now bind all toggles in the radial menu (toggle the active skill, auto-fire weapons, auto-use auxiliary items and auto-boost engine) to keyboard/mouse keys. These options are available under Options -> Auto-use controls.
🎯 [Balance] There has been a plethora of balance changes. In particular, many skills have been buffed and various enemies have been rebalanced. Summoned drones also have lower penalties to resistances during end-game Continuum Events.
🎯 [UI] There is now information regarding the connection status to the master server in the public server listing.
🎯 [UI] The local player map icon is now presented in the transparent map.

So, what's next?
I am currently working on some really cool stuff that have been suggested by many of you. Please keep giving me your awesome suggestions! I promise, I read them all (even if it sometimes takes me a long time to answer). It really makes the dev process a whole lot more fun.

/Hannes

notes.title: Three month update!
notes.notes:
It's now been three months since Nienix reached 1.0!

I am so happy to see so many people playing and enjoying the game! The months past the release (especially the first week) have been intense, but reading your feedback and watching you play really makes it all worth the effort.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/9e1a4ed5cc30f05c5f96924c5514c4217bff2192.gif

So, what is new since 1.0?
There have been 54 patches deployed since 1.0, and significant new features are presented next. The full patch notes, that includes various other added features, bug fixes and balance changes, are available in the community pages as well as on Discord.  

Continuum XXL and World Bosses
A campaign mode above Continuum XL has been added. It is unlocked upon completing the game on Continuum XL. Among other things, Continuum XXL includes five unique world bosses. These are rare and extremely powerful end-game enemies that provide Uber-tier loot when defeated. Each boss has a custom loot table.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/352b601bb01c4eb3f2ed19ad228de640ea7c6255.png

A second skill tree
A second skill tree has been added! You can toggle the activate tree at any time outside of combat (or even during combat, if you have allocated points in the Axiom skill Quick-Swap!). The two skill trees are tied to the two ship hull configurations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c03b56eb72fd26b7ef2fb38c65286a6552f1a5fa.gif

Encyclopedia
The encylopedia contains information about all in-game items and item modifications. You can check which items that support what mods, which effects they provide on different items, as well as read their descriptions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/b7377ba20587ca77b2ff14298af3f7c81885465d.png

Loot filter
A new loot filter has been added! Access it from the inventory (next to the encyclopedia). This new filter is separated for each character. In addition to specifying various filters for all kinds of items, it is also possible to override the default colors for different items and grades. Color overriding is done by manually editing the loot filter for the desired character. The lootfilters are XML-files located under /Data/Save. For instance, the loot filter for the third character (third row) is named "char2_lootfilter.xml".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/498215b1ea2b1f2a8812966ac9b367612fcf0cb7.gif

Instanced loot
It is now possible to designate loot as instanced. The following options are available:
🎯 Free for all: Each loot drop is free for anyone to pick up. (This setting is what was previously available).
🎯 Distance: Each loot drop is locked to a randomly selected player that is located in the sector. Player loot filters are considered for this evaluation.
🎯 Locked: Each loot drop is locked to a randomly selected player regardless of where the player is located. Player loot filters are considered for this evaluation.
The variant called "Distance" is the default value. This can be changed in the Loot section of the main menu options. Item locks are removed once the item has been picked up.

Continuum Transmuter
The Continuum Transmuter UI has undergone revisions to make its components more distinguishable. For example, there is now a preview of the outcome of a transmute. Newly unlocked recipes are now also better highlighted in the UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/b217751baf59d85e4624abfa368a7040792806e7.gif

New skills and item sets
🎯 [New skill] Tiny but Deadly, a Founders T4 skill has been added: If using a Fighter-class non-Sentinel ship, all fixed-weapon bonuses to attack speed, critical hit chance, critical hit damage and elemental damage are increased by 4 (1 point)- 20% (5 points) of their current amount. At max level, this means that a base buff to attack speed of 200% becomes 240%.
🎯 [New skill] Pocket Pulverizer, a Vagrantis T1 skill has been added: If using a non-Sentinel ship that has a diameter less than {0} metres, fixed-weapon damage is increased by {1}%.
🎯 [Item set] A new item set called "Grandius Obliteratus" has been added. This set is especially useful for those who want their drones to wreak havok.
🎯 [Item set] A new item set called "Pocket Deathmachine" has been added. This set has been designed to make Fighter-class non-Sentinel ships stronger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/42d241eb633a8cddf639cdfa681d20aba1c34ef4.gif

Russian localization
All text in the game has been translated to Russian! This work was single-handedly done by @Alekseyzz2078. Many thanks for your help! You can find him on Discord if you have any questions.

Quality of life
🎯 [UI] Properties of drone summons (all but proc-type summons) are now shown in much greater detail - especially in the modal/comprehensive tooltip variant.
🎯 [UI] A new bold font has been added - Noto S Bold. This font also supports Chinese and Russian.

🎯 [UI] Text in the quest log screen and the dialogue screens now account for the desired text scale.
🎯 [UI] Most UI numbers are now prefixed when their value is really high. For example, the hull bar would show "113 K/221 K" instead of "113232/221233".
🎯 [Misc] You can now sort all inventory tabs by right-clicking (X on a controller) the sort button.

🎯 [Misc] It is now possible to let the camera track the cursor. Adjust this setting in Options -> Control Schemes -> Camera.
🎯 [Misc] You can now use your summons (including those summoned through procs), on-board turrets and Sentinel ships in the Arena game mode.
🎯 [Sound effects] It is now possible to adjust weapon sound effects (fixed weapons / summons and on-board turrets / enemies). These settings are available in the audio section of the main menu options.

🎯 [UI] Tutorial text and quest dialogue text now scale a lot higher when the text scale parameter is set to a higher value. For example, the default text size for these widgets is per default 100% larger when playing on the Steam Deck.
🎯 [UI] The quest dialogue text window now scale according to the height of the typed text.
🎯 [UI] Interaction icons for chests and doors now consider the value of "UI Scaling: General text".
🎯 [Misc] The Fleet Commander mode no longer include any line of sight shadows. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Public games with really long names no longer overflow into the player count section.

notes.title: Misc update (some changes reverted)
notes.notes:
Version 1.04251 
🎯 [UI] The scale of world-space counters for damage, XP and warp plasma are now slightly less affected by the UI Scaling: General text option.
🎯 [Balance] The hull has been decreased a bit for the campaign bosses that got buffed by patch 1.0425. 
🎯 [Balance] The "Auto" difficulty option has been restored to how it was pre-1.0425.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0425
🎯 [Arena] You can now set an enemy level up to 99 in the Arena, given that the creating player is at max level (60). Else, the max enemy level is the level of the creating player.
🎯 [Balance] The "Auto" difficulty setting is now set to "Nightmare" when playing COOP with 3 players (previously "Hard") and "Insane" when playing COOP with 5 players (previously "Nightmare"). 
🎯 [Balance] The hull has been increased by ~20% for several campaign bosses. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed several incorrect Chinese and Russian texts.
🎯 [Bug fix] Players could previously, given certain conditions, bypass instance loot checks by using the single-item-pickup-method (in front of collision/bulk). This is no longer the case.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause crit damage to fail to evaluate for some kinds of beam-type weapons.

notes.title: UI update + Continuum XXL in beta branch
notes.notes:
Version 1.0422 
🎯 [UI] Numbers shown for damage, hull gain, warp plasma restoration and XP are now scaled according to the UI: General text setting (see the main menu options).
🎯 [UI] Text scale options are now per default increased for systems with low resolutions, such as the Steam Deck.
🎯 [UI] Text in the quest log screen and the dialogue screens now account for the desired text scale.

---------Beta branch---------
🎯 [Continuum XXL] A campaign mode above Continuum XL has been added. It is unlocked upon completing the game on Continuum XL. In the current build, it is the same experience as Continuum XL, but with all enemies at max level.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0421
🎯 [Performance] Added priority queues for some threaded tasks that previously could cause lag in hectic scenes.
🎯 [Performance] Removed a few redundant unload functions 
🎯 [Performance] Player bots in PvP modes now find paths to explore more quickly.
🎯 [Misc] It is now possible to zoom out a lot further in the Arena- and Fleet Commander game modes.

-----------Beta branch only-----------
🎯 [Fleet Commander] There are now four new (and separate) maps for the Fleet Commander game mode. Fleet Commander maps can now also include world bosses and structures. 
🎯 [Fleet Commander] All units now have map indicators in the Fleet Commander game mode.
🎯 [Fleet Commander] Players now gain additional resources over time as well as when enemy units are destroyed.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0420
🎯 [UI] Soft and hard caps are now presented in the character information screen for fixed-point weapons, drone summons and on-board ship turrets.
🎯 [UI] The DPS of drone weapons are now presented as sum values instead of the average DPS of each individual weapon.
🎯 [Misc] The tutorial station has been removed from Act 1 when playing on Continuum mode.
🎯 [Balance] Soft caps have been introduced for buffs to damage, crit multiplier, crit chance and attack speed. 
🎯 [Performance] Minor performance improvements.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause one of the Founders Trio bosses to be unloaded if moving too far away from it, causing the a soft lock for the boss fight. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused some skills not to be enabled for clients upon first joining a game.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause event-type shops to trigger an incorrect UI message.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause some passive skills that buffed on-board turrets, when first allocated with points, to not be applied until ship switch or game session restart.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused some auras on some weapons to not properly apply crit multipliers (e.g., the Xinthu Hazardous bomb-type weapons).

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Version 1.0419
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue introduced by 1.0418 that caused player skill buffs to sometimes not be correctly applied.

notes.title: Quality of life changes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0416
🎯 [UI] Drone summon and ship turret stats in tooltips are now prefixed when necessary.
🎯 [UI] Properties of drone summons (all but proc-type summons) are now shown in much greater detail - especially in the modal/comprehensive tooltip mode.
🎯 [Misc] Resetting a skill tree at the vendor no longer disarms any items.
🎯 [Bug fix] The cooldown of the Founders T2 skill Emergency Repairs is no longer reset when swapping skill trees.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with the gambler that could cause a lock.

notes.title: Hotfixes to two issues introduced by 1.0414 (the last patch)
notes.notes:
Version 1.0415
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused the experience gained during a level to be reset when swapping skill tree. I am happy to help restore lost XP for those who need it. If so, contact me on Discord. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue in the demo that caused a crash upon character creation.
🎯 [Balance] Resetting a skill tree in at the vendor no longer resets the XP gained for the current level to 0.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0413
🎯 [Misc] You can now sort all inventory tabs by right-clicking (X on a controller) the sort button.
🎯 [Misc] Entity icons in world space are now presented at lower sensor ranges/zoom.
🎯 [Balance] The cooldown of Scanner-type auxiliary items have been increased to match the duration of their provided conditions.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause some bosses to not be unloaded correctly if the player would die during the encounter. The final boss in Act 4 was a notorious such example.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused item hull % debuffs to not be displayed correctly in item tool tips. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error with the Xinthu T4 skill "Precise Aim".

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0412
One of the bug fixes of version 1.0411 also fixed an issue that could cause hull and warp plasma % bonuses to stack given that the player had put points in some specific skills. This was not in the previous patch notes.

🎯 [Balance] The Imperius and Vagrantis skills that provided damage based on max warp plasma/hull have been buffed a bit.
🎯 [Balance] The cap on bonus warp plasma and bonus hull (previously 200%) has been removed.
🎯 [UI] Damage, hull repair and warp plasma gain indicators now apply unit prefixes similar to character portraits.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0411
🎯 [Balance] The Founders T7 skill "Skill Shot" has been buffed a bit more.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error for the item set "Arments of War" that caused an incorrect explosion radius.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that caused some buffs gained from item sets to stack.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0410
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error related to the evaluation order between the Axiom skill "Focused Repairs" and the Vagrantis skill "Obsidian Armor".
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that caused some buffs gained from item sets to stack.

notes.title: Balance update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0407
🎯 [Balance] "Cluster"-type bullets generated by weapons such as the Cluster Missile and Cluster Turbo Grenade now consider the rotation of the payload.
🎯 [Balance] The Damage % bonus cap has been raised to 3000% (up from 1000%).
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T2 skill "Warp Plasma Injector" has been reworked. It now increases warp plasma regeneration by a percentage.
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T3 skill "Turret Damage Booster" has been buffed. It is stronger and now affects turret slot % effectiveness rather than base % damage buffs.
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T2 skill "Fuel For Peanuts" has been buffed - it now reduces engine warp plasma requirement by 50%-100%.
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T4 skill "Rocket Jump" has been buffed - it now increases engine power by 50%.
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T6 skill "Warp Enabled Bullets" has been reworked. It no longer has any skill dependencies and works as follows: Bullet velocity of fixed-point weapons, on-board turrets and summons is first increased by {0}%, and then by an additional {1}% based on the bonus attack speed to fixed-point weapons.
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T7 skill "Omnipotent Fortitude" has been nerfed for smaller ships, but buffed for larger ships as the ship diameter penalty now is reduced (diameter ^ 0.8).
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T7 skill "Warp Plasma Damage Amplifier" has been nerfed.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders T7 skill "Skill Shot" has been nerfed.
🎯 [Balance] The Xinthu T7 skill "Drone Damage Mastery" has been nerfed.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders skill "Molten Metals" now require 3 points to be at max effectiveness.
🎯 [Balance] Player resistance debuffs in Continuum Events have been reduced (this only applies for newly rolled events). 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that caused some active buffs, such as sensor-range buffs from the Scanner Sensor, to not be considered for some damage buff skills for on-board ship turrets.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a race condition in the loot filter that could cause it to not be applied.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that caused network clients to nullify item cooldowns on item swaps.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0405
🎯 [Balance] Shooting range has been increased for scout and fighter summons that have really fast weapons, such as snipers and beam-type weapons.
🎯 [Balance] The Founders skill Molten Metals has been slightly nerfed.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that on rare occasion could cause cave gateways to not spawn. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with the Founders skill Molten Metals: it previously only increased bullet speed, but not bullet lifespan.

notes.title: Performance improvements and changes to cave-type maps
notes.notes:
Version 1.0404
🎯 [Misc] Most maps in Act 2, and all Continuum Event cave maps, have been revised. They are now composed of long windy thick connected tunnels.
🎯 [Performance] Non-essential item loot filter checks (such as those used for rendering) are now managed by a background thread. This should serve to increase performance/reduce lag.
🎯 [Performance] Performance has been improved for most of the maps in Act 2.
🎯 [Balance] Scout-type summons now move closer to their targets before they start shooting, making them behave more like dog fighters than snipers.
🎯 [Bug fix] There was previously a need to re-equip the ship after spending points into the Founders skill "Molten Metals" for it to have an effect on on-board turrets. This requirement has been removed.
🎯 [Bug fix] Conditions are now sorted according to type when evaluated. This should remove many of the weird character stat sheet updates that have been observed - some work on this topic likely remain.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0403
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed several performance issues related to text rendering when playing with Chinese localization. A few menu components had hard-coded fonts that did not support Chinese, causing slow-down due to exception handling.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error related to sensor range calculations when using the sensor buff condition or some of the sensor buff skills.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused latinum to not be shared with client players when playing COOP.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Version 1.03971
🎯 [Balance] The on-hit procs player summons introduced by version 1.0397 has been reverted due to FPS loss for end-game summoner builds that had many summons and many on-hit procs. I will rework this feature a bit before including it.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error for the Melee Maul when under the effect of bonuses to weapon explosion diameter.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0397
🎯 [UI] When playing Continuum and Continuum XL, player and drone resistances pre-reductions are now shown in the character information screen.
🎯 [UI] Enemy portraits are now updated based on damage made by summons. This should improve the experience when playing with pure summoner-builds without any direct player damage.
🎯 [UI] There is now a Neutral option in the storage tab filter to account for non-faction-related items.
🎯 [UI] The hitboxes of the checkboxes in the storage tab filter have been revised.
🎯 [Misc] Previously, the indicator for the currently active quest would switch when moving to other maps to point the player towards the location of the current goal (which then would be through a path of completed goals). This "help" confused many players into thinking the main goal had changed. Thus, this is now not done when moving between different acts.
🎯 [Balance] The area protected by the Deflector Dome now more closely match its hitbox. If a part the ship is outside of the shield, this part can be fired upon.
🎯 [Balance] Consumables and Latinum pickups are now shared across much larger distances. This also solves the previous issue of these not being triggered when using the Bulk loot pickup variant in combination with a high sensor range.
🎯 [Balance] Damage by player summons can now trigger on-hit procs (previously only on-kill procs). This should improve summoner-type builds in end-game.
🎯 [Balance] Auxiliary items can now be used when the attack speed is at -100%.
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T1 skill "Warp Plasma Storage MK1" now provides a % bonus to warp plasma instead of a fixed amount.
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T2 skill "Warp Plasma Storage MK2" has been slightly buffed.
🎯 [Balance] The Axiom T1 skill "Strong Hull" has been slightly nerfed.
🎯 [Balance] Xinthu beam-type weapons no longer collide with friendlies if they are at max hull (i.e., no more collisions with ones own turrets).
🎯 [Balance] All Xinthu-type weapons can now heal friendlies that are not at max hull, and pass through friendlies that are at max hull.
🎯 [Balance] The Xinthu T7 skill "Experimental Catalyst" has been slightly buffed (5% lower reduction to attack speed at level 60).
🎯 [Bug fix] Text of Continuum Entities can now be correctly filtered through the regex filters.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that could cause storage tab regex to be reset when opening/closing the storage screen.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error with the To-2 Fragment and the conversion of ship turret buffs to drone buffs.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error related to several skills that increased warp plasma by a percentage. These did not correctly update the stat sheet % bonus warp plasma statistic.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which caused the Mecha Worm boss in Act 4 to travel far away from its spawn when playing offline/solo campaign.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0396
🎯 [Misc] All tutorial messages and waypoint descriptions have now been translated to Chinese (by 执天之意（WH）).
🎯 [Sound] The volume of the sound effect for continuous beam-type weapons has been reduced.
🎯 [Bug fix] There was an error for the skill "Glacial Strike" that caused it to not reset properly. This is now fixed.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with flight-speed buff conditions that could cause an unintended slowdown when removed.

notes.title: Bug fixes and removed flight speed cap
notes.notes:
Version 1.0395
🎯 [Balance] Removed the flight speed cap in end-game challenges - i agree that it made end-game less fun. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error in one of the Continuum Challenges.
🎯 [Bug fix] Reverted changes to some network subsystems introduced by 1.0394 that could cause synch issues.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Version 1.0393
🎯 [Bug fix] Fix for an issue that made it possible to allocate points in skills that had unfulfilled requirements (insufficient points spent on necessary skills).

notes.title: Change keybindings for fixed weapons + bugfixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0392
🎯 [Misc] It is now possible to rebind the left and right mouse buttons.
🎯 [Balance] The Le Fragment is now less likely to drop.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed several crash-related issues.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with three of the Continuum Challenges could be cheesed due to the increased space alloted around cave portals (introduced by patch 1.035).
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error in the requirements for a Continuum Challenge.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue synching completed Continuum Challenges when playing coop.
🎯 [Bug fix] Added a greater sleep between retries to save the game if a save fails due to an external program locking the save file. Also added a secondary backup system in case saving fails.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error for the Xinthu T4 skill "Precise Aim".

notes.title: Bugfixes and skipped cooldown for player turrets when switching maps
notes.notes:
Version 1.0391
🎯 [Misc] The default camera mode has been switched to "Centered" based on the results from a community poll. 
🎯 [Balance] On-board ship turret weapons are no longer set to cooldown when changing maps.
🎯 [Balance] The Axiom skill "Straight Shooting" has been buffed and now provides 10% less spread per point (up from 5%).
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a crash issue for the "jumper"-type enemies in Act 4. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a race condition that could cause all kinds of weirdness, including crashes and item duplication.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused attack speed debuffs to instead increase attack speed.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.039
🎯 [Misc] The default camera mode has been changed to Cursor.
🎯 [Balance] Weapons are no longer set to cooldown when switching maps.
🎯 [Balance] The level requirement for items produced when gambling now always equals player level.
🎯 [Performance] Minor performance improvements.
🎯 [Balance] The hull has been increased for the ships that need to be rescued in the distress call events.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed another issue that could cause COOP clients to get stuck on loading screen when changing maps.
🎯 [Bug fix] A retry-pattern has been added to handle a case where an external program is accessing save files simultaneously to saving the progress (thus causing failure to save). 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed three crash-related issues that could occur due to race conditions.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an incorrect condition evaluation order for the skills "Obsidian Armor" and "Emergency Repairs".
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug that caused the Emergency Repairs skill to keep the Hull % restored value when the skill was reset.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.038
🎯 [UI] Warp plasma % bonuses are now shown in the character information screen. This statistic has also been added to the item filter. 
🎯 [UI] An option to disable the white screen-flash has been added. This is located under the General section of the main menu options.
🎯 [UI] Recipe configs that currently provide a random outcome in terms of item grade are now better presented in the item preview slot.
🎯 [Balance] The Imperius T7 skill Drone Mastery III has been revised. It now works as follows: Time between summoning drones is reduced by {0}%. Drone resistances are increased by {1}% of the warp plasma bonus %. Warp plasma required to summon drones is increased by {2}%. 
🎯 [Balance] The Ga, Co, Ra, Un and Ep Fragments now sets the level of the transmuted item to the same level as the player. In other words, you can not both up- and down-level items with these fragments. 
🎯 [Balance] The final boss in Act 2 has been revised. In particular, the map is now larger.
🎯 [Balance] Cave entries and exits now spawn in a bit less confined spaces.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause COOP clients to get stuck on loading screen when changing maps.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed the evaluation order of several high-level skills that previously failed to include % hull and % warp plasma buffs.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug that could cause non-weapon-type mods on drone summoner items to be incorrectly re-rolled on Continuum Transmuter recipes.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed another cave-entrance-spawning-in-wall-edge-case.
🎯 [Bug fix] The map that contains the first Nienix fragment has been enlarged. Larger ships should thus no longer get out-of-bounds when going there.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Version 1.0371
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a crash bug in the Continuum Transmuter introduced by 1.037.

notes.title: Bug fixes and balance changes
notes.notes:
Version 1.037
🎯 [Continuum Transmuter] The item preview is now only shown for known recipes.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that caused buffs from toggle-type Active Auxiliary items to stay active even when the warp plasma reached 0.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause boost conditions to remain active when the engine was disarmed.
🎯 [Bug fix] The description fields for Drone Resistance Augments were incorrect - this has been fixed.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error with Wave Spawners that on rare occasion could cause an enemy to spawn behind a wall or door.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error that caused the transmute preview to be applied without a transmute being required for some recipes (this was introduced by 1.036).
🎯 [Balance] Some Continuum Events have been revised, e.g., with safe starting points added.

notes.title: Quality of life changes and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.035
🎯 [Misc] There is now a dedicated hotkey for dropping inventory items. The keybinding is located under "Menu controls". The default key is V (keyboard) and B (controller).
🎯 [Misc] The radial menu can now also be pressed-released instead of toggled (similar to item popups). 
🎯 [Misc] The Cursor-type camera now centers on the player when the cursor is relatively close to the center of the screen.
🎯 [Bug fix] The cave builder has been reworked. Apart fixing the issue that could allocate cave gateways in unreachable locations, entities (such as portals, enemies and collideables) should now be placed more uniformely across the maps.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error in summon tooltips introduced by 1.034.

notes.title: Bugfixes and balance update
notes.notes:
Version 1.034
🎯 [Misc] Stage 3 of the Act 4 Boss Axiom Behemoth MK-1 has been revised.
🎯 [Balance] Enemy damage has been slightly increased overall, in particular for the early stages of the game.
🎯 [Bug fix] Event-type enemies are now returned to their original position when removed from physics. This Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to be pushed through walls while in inactive cells and waiting to be removed from physics. 
🎯 [Bug fix] Really small % chance bonuses are now properly shown in tooltips instead of as +0%.
🎯 [Bug fix] There was a bug related to summon damage and health in tooltips. This is now fixed.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a crash-related issue that could occur when loading a few kinds of items in some UIs, e.g., when re-rolling items in the Gambler.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a crash-related issue in the Arena mode.

notes.title: A new bold font and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Version 1.033
🎯 [Font] A new bold font has been added - Noto S Bold. This font also supports Chinese.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue in the comparison item tooltip (for the velocity statistic).
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which in theory could add large promoted enemies to small spaces (introduced by 1.032).
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a second issue that on rare occasion could cause transitions in asteroids/caves (most notably in Act 2) to spawn in unreachable locations.

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 1.02
🎯 [Misc] The Orbital Station dungeon in Act 1 now includes a boss fight.
🎯 [Performance] Performance has been improved when many bomb-type enemies are active.
🎯 [Sound effect] The sound effect used when landing to a station platform or toggling the character info sheet has been removed.
🎯 [Balance] Enemy damage has been slightly increased for the normal difficulty.
🎯 [Balance] The boss room of Station D-5 Level 4 has been enlarged.
🎯 [Balance] Enemy aggro range has been increased for the first few levels (where it previously was really low).
🎯 [Balance] The warp plasma requirement of the mine summon has been increased.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with bomb-type summons exploding too early.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with camera movement in the main menu.
🎯 [Bug fix] Previously, the game would exit if a folder named Exceptions could not be created in the game root directory upon init. This is no longer the case.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue which on rare occasion would cause clients to crash when logging into a server.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue with the "Defeat X enemies" achievements that could cause them to fail to be completed (if they were completed when the machine could not send the achievement completion to the Steam server).

notes.title: Misc update
notes.notes:
Version 0.910
🎯 [Balance] The Vagrantis T3 skill Turret Damage Booster has been buffed.
🎯 [Balance] Elite enemy hull has been revised for the regular campaign.
🎯 [Balance] There is now a cooldown on stun (max once per 30 seconds). This applies to both enemies and players.
🎯 [Balance] The frozen condition is now less effective against bigger ships/hulls. This applies to both enemies and players, although the bonus is greater for players.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug that could cause players to become invincible and gain wallhack when switching maps in the PvP modes.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug in the Arena game mode that caused some enemies and bosses to fail to properly spawn.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a crash issue that was introduced by patch 0.905.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed some incorrect texts.

notes.title: Balance changes
notes.notes:
Version 0.905
🎯 [Balance] The damage and range of many weapons have been buffed (only applies to newly obtained items). 
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an error with the procedural spawn position of an entrance to an asteroid in Act 2.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue in the path finding system that could cause a crash.

notes.title: A new skill, a new event, and various other changes!
notes.notes:
Version 0.900
🎯 [Skill] A new Vagrantis T3 skill called "Turret Damage Booster" has been added: On-board turret damage is increased based on the number of available turrets. Fewer turrets mean more damage.
🎯 [UI] Updated some particle effects.
🎯 [UI] Bullet spread is now shown in weapon tooltips.
🎯 [UI] Adding/removing a sensor now causes a smoother zooming effect.
🎯 [Misc] The map with the final boss in Act 2 has been revised to make it maneuverable with slightly bigger ships
🎯 [Misc] Several maps in Act 2 have been enlarged.
🎯 [Misc] Revised the tutorial map.
🎯 [Event] A new event has been added to Act 4.
🎯 [Performance] Performance improvements have been made by drawing less details for small entities when a low zoom is employed.
🎯 [Performance] Performance improvements have been made by changing some key data structures.
🎯 [Performance] Path finding has been made alot faster in cave-type events/maps.
🎯 [Balance] Removed the sensor debuff clouds in some maps in Act 2.
🎯 [Balance] Elite enemies in PvP maps now have significantly more hull.
🎯 [Balance] Bulk pickup range is no longer related to ship size (i.e., only to sensor range).
🎯 [Balance] The crit damage cap has been increased by 2x.
🎯 [Balance] Bullet spread has been reduced for the BF Cannon.
🎯 [Balance] Turrets effectiveness has been buffed for larger ships based on their number of turrets. Turrets on a large ship with few turrets are slightly more effective than those on a large ship with many turrets.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed the evaluation order of buffs to correctly convert active buffs for the Axiom T7 skill "Armament Transformer".
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug that caused some on-board turret buffs to not be applied correctly.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a background tile that sometimes was rendered incorrectly.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed a bug in the tutorial - the correct dialogue failed to load upon equipping the dropped engine.
🎯 [Bug fix] Fixed an issue that could cause enemies and summons to follow incorrect paths.

notes.title: Wave-defense events, UI updates and changes to sensor range!
notes.notes:
Version 0.850
🎯 [Wave events] A completely new kind of event has been added - enemy waves events! Defeat all incoming waves of enemies to obtain a prize.
🎯 [Event] A wave-defense event has been added to Act 1. 
🎯 [Event] A wave-defense event has been added to Act 4.

notes.title: Christmas update that includes Act 4!
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas!

Today's patch brings a plethora of new features to the main branch:

Act 4
🎯 Act 4 can now be explored by all players! This act includes 60 new enemies and four campaign bosses. 
🎯 If you have unlocked Continuum Mode previous to this patch, Continuum Mode will be locked. Don't panic: all your progress, unlocked waypoints and such from playing Continuum Mode are still there. However, you need to finish Act 4 first to enter Continuum Mode. At that point, Continuum Mode will be unlocked and your previous progress during Continuum Mode made available.
🎯 To enter Act 4, complete the final mission in Act 3.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/c05c54d980da360a181334549df521e1803f222b.gif

Level cap increased to 60
🎯 You can now level up to 60!

Continuum XL
🎯 Continuum XL brings various changes to the core game experience and is unlocked by completing Act 4 on Continuum Mode. 

Grand and Uber Continuum Events
🎯 Grand and Uber Continuum Events have now been added to the game. These events are end-game dungeons with special loot available in Continuum XL.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/3df5c4afeaa63f3e55eb52a3bfe058cc3b3bc670.gif

New items
🎯 Item sets: 16 item sets have been added! These can drop for Mythic and higher item grades. Their drop rate is significantly increased during Continuum XL, especially towards the end, as well as in Continuum Events (based on their difficulty).
🎯 Uber-grade items: These items that only are dropped in Grand and Uber Continuum Events.
🎯 Stationary Indestructible Hull: An Active Auxiliary Item that generates an aura which provides temporary invulnerability to all allies within its range.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/0f8f83ddcce141c7b090d497d4c6edbc83e6555d.png

New skills
🎯 Flux Deflector (Founders Tier 3): Damage taken from a single hit can at most inflict X% of your max hull. Your hull regeneration is reduced by Y%.
🎯 Hardened Tail (Axiom Tier 2): Direct damage to Sentinel tail segments is reduced by X%-Y%, where damage reduction is higher for segments further away from the head. 
🎯 Emergency Repairs (Founders Tier 2): The player is instantly brought back to life with X% hull upon suffering fatal damage, and is then invulnerable for Y seconds. Has a cooldown of Z minutes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/03ca7ce4dafc72b549b24b529f4c00b245375480.png

Quality-of-life updates
🎯 Enable/disable bullet on-hit effects: You can now enable or disable bullet on-hit-effects for different sources. 
🎯 The map UI has been revised to make navigation easier.
🎯 Many sprites have been polished.
🎯 You can now choose which map modes that are enabled. This setting is located under the General settings section (the option "Enabled map modes"). The default setting is "All"
🎯 Simplified Chinese is now supported! This localization was single-handedly done by 执天之意(WH)! If you have a Chinese language set in your operating system, it should automatically change the language to simplified Chinese the first time the game is started post this patch.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37916769/324d4d158fe9df3086f25125424dd83cbbb51275.png

Other news: while more content and changes are planned for early access, Nienix is on track for a Q1 2023 release. 

Hope to see you all in game!

/Hannes

This patch makes looting a lot more convenient!


 [Loot] It is now possible to set loot filters in the character information screen!
 [Loot] There are now three options regarding loot pickups: 
  Standard: Pressing the interact button causes the loot closest to the player to be picked up. (This is the default variant)
  Collision: All loot is picked up automatically upon collision with the player.
  Bulk: Pressing the interact button causes all items in a large area around the player to be picked up.
 [Act 3] Reduced the Hull of "bullet hell" turrets by 70%. Also increased their loot a bit.
 [UI] Fixed a few incorrect item names.
 [Shop] The "Identify all" button in the shop now identifies all items in all inventory tabs instead of only the active tab.
 [Skill] Xinthu skill "Enhanced Shields" [1:2]: Now 3% buff per level (up from 1%).
 [Skill] Imperius skill "Frost Shield" [4:1]: Now 6% buff per level (up from 5%).
 [Bug] Beam-type weapons now work as expected with the TNT modification.
 [Bug] Skills that added AOEs upon usage of an active auxiliary item did not work properly if the item already generated an AOE of the same type. Now fixed.

notes.title: Heavy Gunships Update!
notes.notes:
The demo and beta tester build have been updated!

This update contains a range of new features:

 Frigates, cruisers and motherships have been added to the loot tables. These are heavier than light gunships. To compensate, they have more hull and are equipped with turrets. 
 There is now a "Flight Assist" option that if enabled causes the ship to slowly stop if the player is not attempting to move.
 Various bugs have been patched. Example fixed bugs include corrections to AI pathfinding and AOE colliders, and a bug related to screen resolutions for multi-monitor setups.
 Several significant performance increases have been made.
